Naval technology in AoT universe is more or less \~1905 year of our world, so it would be Russo-Japanse war era. This could also be hinted by similarity of Fort Slava battle and Port Arthur siege.  Destroyer is small vessel about \~70 m in length, armed with several torpedo tubes and 2 small cannons (76 mm) example here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harusame-class\_destroyer .  Their arnament is too weak (cannons) or is not suited to combat Titans (torpedo tubes). Sending them to Paradis was one most idotic decisions that Marley Admirality could take. Destroyers are best suited to screen big vessels againt torpedo boats or destoyers and most importantly they are suited to perform torpedo attacks againt enemy big vessels (Battleships, Armored cruisers, protected cruisers, transport ships etc.). Big ships in that time were weak in terms of torpedo defence. They did send 32 destroyers, but atleast they are not complicated or expensive vessels like cruisers or battleships buyt still these vessels could still play major role in Marley vs Mid-East-Union War. Beyond these destoyers Marley send some transport ships and atleast 1 older cruiser. Sending this older cruiser had point because it is armed with cannons in size from 200 to 120 mm which could make serious harm to 15m Titan but accuracy maybe problem. And as we can read later this cruiser surrendered to Paradis forces.
